_comment: Anima Base v1 example. Replace LoRA filenames, triggerPrompt and basePrompt with the exact values used by your LoRA.
_turbo_note: Optional Anima Turbo/speed LoRA applied to every render. Leave empty for normal base generation.
_global_lora_note: Optional model-only Anima LoRAs applied to every character. Usually leave this empty and use characterProfiles.
_profile_note: One server handles all characters. Wayward talentName selects the matching profile. triggerPrompt is the LoRA activation token; basePrompt is the character identity description that must stay stable across scenes.

elena.gamePromptPrefixToStrip: masterpiece, best quality, 1girl, original game identity tags
